headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of July 8, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 15.25% compared to SPY's 9.86%. This results in a current average alpha of 5.39%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but are also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A,' has delivered an impressive return of 41.53%, significantly contributing to the overall outperformance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Google 100,' has returned 7.96%, still above the benchmark but less impactful. This relative strength against SPY is particularly notable during periods of market uncertainty, showcasing the portfolio's resilience. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
